purpose: Curated prospective-client questions to answer on snsco.in. Educational answers only (BCI Rule 36). Not yet researched or written. Source: legal-query-bank in firm profile/seo-deliverables.
answer_standard: Answer the question directly in the first paragraph, in general terms, as on a stated date
State the governing statute, forum, time limits and procedure; confirm every provision and case from two sources
Say plainly where the law is unsettled or differs by State
No call to contact the firm, no 'we can help', no fee or free-consultation language, no results or experience claims
No client stories, names or outcomes; hypotheticals labelled as such
Link to related guides, articles and the glossary; no comparisons with other lawyers
